caption: An iron rod rests with one end buried in the glowing coals of a forge, and the buried end begins to glow dull red and brightens toward orange.

sa.check: An iron rod rests with one end in the glowing coals of a forge.
The buried end begins to glow.
The glow spreads a short way along the rod.
The far end of the rod stays dark.
The rod is dark before it is in the coals.

pc.expect: The glow only brightens and spreads a little while the end stays in the coals; it does not fade or retreat.
pc.fail: The glow fades while the end stays buried in the coals; or the glow brightens and dims in turn; or the glowing part goes dark and glows again; or the glow spreads to the far end and then retreats.

pc.expect: The glow appears only on the part in the coals and spreads a short way out of them, while the rest of the rod stays dark.
pc.fail: The glow appears at the rod's far end away from the coals; or the whole rod glows evenly including the end held clear; or the rod's buried end stays dark while the coals glow around it to the end of the clip; or the glow appears before the rod is in the coals.

pc.expect: The rod stays a rigid bar that keeps its shape while glowing and can be moved as one piece.
pc.fail: The glowing end sags or droops with nothing bending it; or the rod drips as a liquid; or the rod bends into a curve by itself; or the rod swells where it glows.

pc.expect: The rod rests on the coals or the forge's edge and any sparks or smoke from the coals rise.
pc.fail: The rod lifts off the coals and hangs in the air; or sparks fall through the forge and lie glowing below; or the smoke sinks and pools around the forge; or the rod floats above the fire.

pc.expect: One rod and one bed of coals; the rod stays one bar and the coals keep their number.
pc.fail: The rod vanishes; or a second rod appears; or the rod passes through the forge's floor; or a coal vanishes leaving no ash.

pc.expect: The forge's body, the coals' bed and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The forge changes colour; or the coals rearrange away from the rod; or items around the forge rearrange.

note: How bright the glow gets is not judged, only that it brightens one way and appears where the rod is in the coals.
